dog.description_text:
Meet Salsalita, a social butterfly!

With her big puppy dog eyes and bouncy ears, Salsalita will steal your heart! She loves going for walks, playing with other dogs, and making new friends. She's also a total lovebug who enjoys being close to her people and will happily lean right into you for pets and affection. Salsalita has also shown herself to be good on the leash, and is clearly just as happy outside!

Whether she's out exploring or cuddled up soaking in all the love, this girl is happiest when she's by your side. She's full of love, sweetness, and puppy charm, and she's ready to find a loving family. If you’re looking for a happy girl to bring some flavor to your life, Salsalita is available to meet now!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
